infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app requires camera access to capture verified ground and canopy evidence for carbon MRV.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app requires photo library access to upload existing field evidence.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app requires location access to geotag plantation coordinates and view your position on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: This app requires location access to geotag plantation coordinates.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Carbon Credit Marketplace to access your camera to capture ground evidence.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Carbon Credit Marketplace to access your photos to select field evidence.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Carbon Credit Marketplace to use your location to geotag plantations.
